Why post oak and cedar?

It's the hardwood Central Texas is known for. Dense, slow burning, great coals and few sparks. It's also what Texas BBQ is built on. Cedar lights fast and smells great, so it gets the fire going.

  • Fireplace · hot, long burns on cold nights
  • Fire pit · a bundle is about one evening
  • Smoker · brisket, ribs and pork butts
  • Camping · fits next to the cooler
  • Cedar · quick to catch, and that campfire smell
